from __future__ import annotations

import json
import typing

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from llm_router._api.errors import ProviderError
from llm_router._api.types import Model, Provider
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content
from llm_router._internal.providers.base import ProviderCredential, ProviderRequest
from llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat import (
    QwenChatAdapter,
    json_headers,
    transport_failure,
)
from py_lib_testkit._internal.test_support.http import ScriptedResponse
from tests.llm_router.support.fault_server import ScriptedHTTPServer
from tests.llm_router.support.workers.retry import (
    qwen_chat_path,
    qwen_error_response,
    qwen_success_response,
    qwen_upload_path,
    qwen_upload_success_response,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")

UPLOADED_URL = "https://cdn.example.invalid/uploaded-ref.png"


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def unreachable_proxy_env(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    for name in ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY"):
        monkeypatch.setenv(name, "http://127.0.0.1:1")
    monkeypatch.setenv("NO_PROXY", "")
    monkeypatch.delenv("no_proxy", raising=False)


@pytest.fixture
def server() -> typing.Iterator[ScriptedHTTPServer]:
    with ScriptedHTTPServer() as scripted:
        yield scripted


def make_request(content: object) -> ProviderRequest:
    credential = ProviderCredential(key_id=1, env_var="ENV_VAR", value="neutral")
    return ProviderRequest(
        request_id="req-boundary",
        provider=Provider.QWENCHAT,
        model=Model.QWEN_MAX_LATEST,
        provider_model="qwen-max",
        credential=credential,
        messages=[normalize_content(content)],
    )


def media_content() -> list[object]:
    return ["describe this", Image.new("RGB", (2, 2))]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_upload_retry_then_single_chat_with_headers_and_payload(
    server: ScriptedHTTPServer,
) -> None:
    server.enqueue(
        qwen_upload_path(),
        ScriptedResponse(503, body=qwen_error_response(status_code=503, message="busy")),
    )
    server.enqueue(
        qwen_upload_path(),
        ScriptedResponse(200, body=qwen_upload_success_response(url=UPLOADED_URL)),
    )
    server.enqueue(
        qwen_chat_path(),
        ScriptedResponse(200, body=qwen_success_response(text="proxy text")),
    )
    request = make_request(media_content())
    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url=server.base_url, timeout_seconds=5.0)

    result = await adapter.aexecute(request)

    assert result.output_text == "proxy text"
    paths = [record.path for record in server.requests]
    assert paths == [qwen_upload_path(), qwen_upload_path(), qwen_chat_path()]
    chat = server.requests[-1]
    sent = {key.lower(): value for key, value in chat.headers.items()}
    expected = json_headers(request)
    assert expected
    for key, value in expected.items():
        assert sent.get(key.lower()) == value
    body = json.loads(chat.body)
    assert body["model"] == "qwen-max"
    assert UPLOADED_URL in chat.body.decode()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_upload_provider_error_is_raised_without_chat(
    server: ScriptedHTTPServer,
) -> None:
    server.enqueue(
        qwen_upload_path(),
        ScriptedResponse(
            400, body=qwen_error_response(status_code=400, message="bad upload")
        ),
    )
    request = make_request(media_content())
    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url=server.base_url, timeout_seconds=5.0)

    with pytest.raises(ProviderError, match=r".+") as exc_info:
        await adapter.aexecute(request)

    assert exc_info.value.provider == Provider.QWENCHAT
    assert exc_info.value.model == Model.QWEN_MAX_LATEST
    assert [record.path for record in server.requests] == [qwen_upload_path()]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_configured_timeout_is_applied(server: ScriptedHTTPServer) -> None:
    server.enqueue(
        qwen_chat_path(),
        ScriptedResponse(
            200,
            body=qwen_success_response(text="slow"),
            delay_seconds=0.6,

    request = make_request("hello")
    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url=server.base_url, timeout_seconds=0.2)

    with pytest.raises(ProviderError, match=r".+"):
        await adapter.aexecute(request)
